//: The connector packages Phoenix comes with (docs/SYNERGY-CONNECTORS.md 7, 'What comes with Phoenix'): installed in the image as apps the user may remove (/media/cryptofs/apps; tools/install-rootfs.py, phoenix-sim's and tools/serve-rootfs.py's installed apps, runtime/rootfs.json 'preinstalled'), counted by the Marketplace as installed from the catalog sourceId, and installed again from it without Developer Mode (packagesservice.js firstPartyEntry).

from: where the package's app is in this checkout (for the tools that build the image and the simulator); service and templates: its connector service and account templates, for the simulator's runtime.
Google, Microsoft, Telegram and LoRa mesh join this list when they are built.

catalog: Phoenix's own connector packages that are NOT pre-installed but installed from the catalog by those who want them (the drives, docs/SYNERGY-CONNECTORS.md 7): the device trusts them as Phoenix's own from a catalog it ships with (installed without Developer Mode, as the pre-installed ones are installed again); their folders (apps/connectors/) are not apps of the image or the simulator until installed.
